themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Articles discussing AI agents that can perform research tasks autonomously or semi-autonomously, including research infrastructure and workflows.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Focuses on AI tools that assist in writing, reviewing, and debugging code, including AI agents for coding tasks and security.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Covers a broad range of AI applications used to enhance research processes, including AI platforms, tools for specific research needs, and AI's role in scientific discovery.

themes.name: AI chatbot research
themes.description: Explores the use, impact, and safety of AI chatbots, including their role in mental health, patient care, and user interaction.

themes.name: AI workforce impact
themes.description: Articles discussing how AI is reshaping jobs, impacting hiring, skill demands, and the overall labor market, including fears of job loss and creation.

themes.name: AI research tools comparison
themes.description: Articles that compare different AI research tools, models, or platforms, evaluating their performance, features, and pricing.

themes.name: Synthetic users
themes.description: Discusses the creation and use of synthetic data or individuals for AI training, research, and testing, including deepfakes and AI-generated personas.

themes.name: AI for design & research
themes.description: Covers AI applications specifically in the design process, including generative design, AI-assisted design tools, and AI's influence on design workflows and user experience.

themes.name: AI sentiment feedback
themes.description: Focuses on AI's ability to analyze and interpret user sentiment, feedback, reviews, and opinions, particularly in marketing and product contexts.

themes.name: AI testing automation
themes.description: Examines the use of AI in automating software testing, quality assurance, and deployment processes, including AI's role in identifying vulnerabilities and ensuring code quality.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
